global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and a whole soft-boiled egg nestled among noodles. Served in a white bowl, it rests on a warm wooden table under soft, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, subtle rim, and faint orange residue along inner edge.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains thin noodles, green onions, and a soft-boiled egg.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale yellowish-white, smooth and slightly glossy, oval-shaped with subtle surface variations.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with slight fat marbling and a glossy surface.
